# Source notices

The authored Stellar Forge VGI integration uses the original project's MIT license. Existing buyer, Python cohort, Applications and warehouse modules retain their original notices.

Query.Farm's VGI SDK is source available under its own license. Its package and source notices remain with the exact original wheel. The selected SDK is vgi-python 0.43.1, release commit bf8b0b3902e1ff165ac413e4a216801f03ed8693:

https://github.com/Query-farm/vgi-python/tree/bf8b0b3902e1ff165ac413e4a216801f03ed8693

The publisher describes its source-available terms at:

https://query.farm/licenses/source-available/

The selected VGI-RPC package is vgi-rpc 0.51.0, commit ca89b6d9c0d793cf8d708103d9cd1abf5f808271, under its original Apache-2.0 license:

https://github.com/Query-farm/vgi-rpc-python/tree/ca89b6d9c0d793cf8d708103d9cd1abf5f808271

Waitress 3.0.2 retains its Zope Public License 2.1 notices. DuckDB 1.5.6 retains its MIT license. Apache Arrow/PyArrow retains its Apache-2.0 notices. The original Python cohort records and transfers the complete resolved wheels, including their native metadata and license files.

The VGI SQL extension is installed by a receiving DuckDB client through the publisher's original community distribution. Its exact installed extension identity is recorded by the operating receiving workflow.

Original acquired data, public-source pages, export dictionaries and source meaning remain under their original issuer provenance. This component keeps those source identities in every publication.
